game_concept: A adventure race set in Eldritch Ruins – Eldritch Heart, the glowing heart of the ruins: the rune scholar must handle rune wisps while practicing lists. Core idea – Comprehension Lab: Build new lists in one line with list comprehensions to transform relic shards.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Eldritch Heart: the glowing heart of the ruins
core_gameplay_loop: In Eldritch Heart, repeat each round: Build new lists in one line with list comprehensions to transform relic shards. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the rune scholar ahead. Then check the lab_output value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the crypt seal by solving code steps involving lab_output that move the rune scholar forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.0).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the crypt seal first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 5 (applied tier): Comprehension Lab
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comprehension Lab' (Week 7 slot 11), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Eldritch Heart'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lab_output changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rune wisps in Eldritch Heart.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.0).
